name: judge_subagent_results
description: Adjudicate or rank multiple delegated worker results using a structured rubric. Use this after parallel subagents return when you need a separate judging pass instead of asking the main worker to merge results implicitly. Returns a validated accepted, needs_changes, or insufficient_evidence verdict. Only accepted results tied to owned worker receipts for the current source state can satisfy a Nexus independent-review gate.

decision_mode.description: single_best selects one candidate; top_k selects required_winner_count. Defaults to top_k when more than one winner is requested.
